page.overview:
Who is Takima Deraighdin?

Takima has long black hair and skin the color of aged ivory. She is a tiny, bird-like woman and stands 5'1" or 155 cm in height., Takima Deraighdin}} However small, quiet and observant by nature, she can still be forceful if she wishes.

Takima is of average strength for an Aes Sedai, with a One Power level of . She would not be able to Travel without linking with another channeler.

Takima has a formidable memory. She remembers everything she reads. Takima could recognize one of her pupils at a hundred paces.

Takima was born in in the Mountains of Mist
